newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's May 1997 cement output up 21.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's May 1997 cement output up 21.4 pct.

text.p: Mexico's gray cement production in May 1997 was 2.574 million tonnes, up 21.4 percent compared with the 2.12 million tonnes in May 1996, the National Cement Chamber said.
May's output was the highest registered in the past 17 months, up from the the 2.397 million tonnes in April 1997, according to a chamber report obtained by Reuters.
The production and consumption of cement is one of the raw materials most tied to the industrial sector and can be seen as a sign of the construction industry's health.
Before the 1995 economic crisis and the peso's devaluation, the cement industry ran at 82.3 percent of its installed capacity for a record output of 30 million tonnes in 1994.
